notes.title: Build 0.60.1 - Enemy Wave Combat Simulator Pod
notes.content:
Build 0.60.1
Enemy Wave Combat Simulator Pod – New Features and Fixes
[hr][/hr]

[previewyoutube="Cd_9xrwWGTI;full"][/previewyoutube]✨ Highlights
New Combat Simulation Capsule: Right at the start of the game, you can now experience what it feels like to play with a full armor set and all crystals at Maximum Tier. The capsule is a clandestine Augmented Reality device, created so that exiles could train, increase their survival chances, and maybe one day challenge their oppressors on fairer grounds.

In this mode, sequential waves of enemies are spawned, and the challenge is to see how long you can survive.

📍 How to access: A quest has been added right after the training with Edgar.



[hr][/hr]

✨ Next Steps for the Demo
The Demo’s scope is practically closed. Upcoming updates will focus on improvements and increasing the density of the experience.

One system still planned for the Demo is the relationship system with one of the village gangs, the “Poachers”, who control the village’s food supply. They will have routines tied to this lore, can be attacked, and will retaliate, directly impacting your social relationship with the gang.

[hr][/hr]

🛠️ New Systems Already Implemented in the Demo
Creation of soldiers from the Royal Gomo of Omahum, positioned at the POD landing zone to guard the capsule.

Addition of loot crates scattered throughout the world, which can be opened either by force or with specific codes.

Addition of a capsule/pod at the POD landing zone.

[hr][/hr]

🎮 Improvements Implemented in the Demo
Reestablished the footstep sound system.

Improved password box UI.

Adjusted the axe position when sheathed.

Improved NPC routines and dialogues.

Remote Play fixes and improvements.

Dungeon elevator now descends after defeating FatMaxper.

Added new NPC routine: they now guard the warehouse and patrol near the food sacks around the Heliport.

Adjusted snow color for consistency.

Added some dynamic shadows.

Modified the walls of Druvir’s greenhouse.

[hr][/hr]


👉 This update introduces the Combat Simulation Capsule, new world systems, technical improvements, and gameplay adjustments, delivering more immersion, progression, and variety to the Demo experience.


[hr][/hr]

📢 Final Notes
This is still a work-in-progress version. We are adjusting multiple systems and mechanics, so compatibility issues with save files between updates may occur.
 If you encounter difficulties loading your progress, we recommend starting a new game and replacing your previous save.
 We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding!


[hr][/hr]

💬 Your Feedback Is Very Important!
Share suggestions, bug reports, or impressions directly on our Discord: 👉
 

https://discord.gg/AXP5R7Q

notes.title: Build 0.59.0
notes.content:
Build 0.59.0
New Features and Fixes
[hr][/hr]

✨ Highlights
New basic player movement with motion matching. This technology makes animations feel more natural and significantly improves the overall gamefeel.


Performance optimizations applied across several areas of the game, resulting in a smoother experience for all players.

[hr][/hr]

✨ Next Steps for the Demo
Combat Simulation System – Training Mode (Singleplayer)


Loot chests with predefined resistance levels: depending on the damage type of your attacks, you may be able to break them open. These chests can also be unlocked with secret codes that you’ll be able to discover in different ways throughout the game.


Combat Simulation System – Training Mode (PVP)


A new combat style with Gauntlet and Shield is nearly complete. However, it will only be available in the scope of Early Access. Stay tuned on YouTube, where we’ll soon share more content about new areas and new creatures.

[hr][/hr]

🛠️ New Systems Already Implemented in the Demo
Voice lines added to some NPCs.


New narrative camera when interacting with NPC dialogues.


New party system: you can now use potions on companions.


New aerial attack (low-speed jump strike).


Option to disable snow effects for improved performance.


New Beer consumable, which applies a timed effect.


Dynamic snow deformation system implemented in certain areas.

[hr][/hr]

🎮 Improvements Implemented in the Demo
Improved Koxi behavior.


Improved Fat Maxper behavior.


Implementation of Buffs and Debuffs from animal skills.


Adjustments to Motion Blur.


Fixed sound issues in the shop.


Counter now applies a longer Stun.


Camera adjustment: Urian now appears centered at the bottom.


Improved combat against Edgar.


Fixed narrative choices in dialogues and quests.


Enhanced navigation system (NavMesh).


New Socket system: crystals are no longer lost when equipped.


Intro video subtitles revised.


All Refurbish equipment now includes a Socket slot.


Fixed overlapping instructions in the UI.


Komikaska Uvixa now also drops Gastric Juice.


Urian reaches Level 2 faster (by defeating 3 Komikaskas).


Added dead Komikaska body in the forest to support Quest 2 (Edgar).


10% speed reduction for Komikaskas.


New images added to the Social Menu.


New default images for NPCs on the map.


Expanded interaction box with Peter.


Peter’s counter now has proper collision.


NPCs are no longer climbable.


Updated text for Quest 1 (Edgar).


Peter’s quest now includes a Waypoint for loot.


Quest 1 (Edgar) now requires buying a beer.


New cinematic when solving puzzles.

[hr][/hr]


👉 This update delivers performance optimizations, combat improvements, new progression systems, and narrative adjustments, making the experience more fluid and immersive.


[hr][/hr]

📢 Final Notes
This is still a work-in-progress version. We are adjusting multiple systems and mechanics, so compatibility issues with save files between updates may occur.
 If you encounter difficulties loading your progress, we recommend starting a new game and replacing your previous save.
 We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding!

💎 Dungeon Body Loot Crystal Fixed – Can no longer be consumed.

🐛 Koxi Uvixa Spawn Fixed – Properly spawning in the intended area.

⚰️ Fail-Safe Floor Added in Dungeon – Falling now results in death, as intended.
[hr][/hr]🌍 World Building
🌲 Forest Landscape Improvements – Fixed areas where mobs were getting stuck.

👣 Footprint Trails Added in the Village – Small details to enhance immersion.

notes.title: Build 0.49
notes.content:
🛠️ Patch Notes – Demo Update
🆕 Main New Features
- Party System is fully functional
- Local Coop enabled with split-screen support
- Remote Play Together is available (for testing purposes)
- New enemy added: Koxi Uvixa, a Champion-type enemy

⚙️ Development
- Extra version of Urian that was spawning unintentionally has been fixed
- Added a pop-up message after defeating FatMaxper (BOSS) indicating the end of the demo experience
- Fixed a combo bug with Edgar when playing in local coop
- Ragdoll physics added for Urian, FatMaxper, and Edgar
- Koxi Uvixa enemy implemented, classified as Champion

🌍 World Building
- New light bake for improved visual fidelity
- FPS improvements due to optimization of the snow system implementation

🎮 Game Design
- Adjustments to Edgar's final quest for smoother experience flow
- Improved quest progression flow overall
- Updated Target Points to align with new quest objectives
- Translation updates applied
- Reworked Severino’s Quest 1 for better narrative consistency
- Added visual indicator for the Fungus quest to improve guidance

📢 Final Notes
🔧 This is still a work-in-progress demo.
We are actively adjusting many systems and features, so save file issues may occur between updates. If you encounter problems loading your game, we recommend starting a new game and overwriting the previous save. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding!

💬 Your feedback is extremely valuable!
